changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: Register the dashboards.view.management permission key and gate its page URL
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module (id, name, description, has_select_flag, has_add_flag, has_update_flag, has_delete_flag) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_seq'), 'dashboards.view.management', 'View Management Dashboard', 'Y', 'N', 'N', 'N' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module WHERE name = 'dashboards.view.management');
INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module_url (id, url_path, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_url_seq'), '/dashboards/management', m.id FROM clinlims.system_module m WHERE m.name = 'dashboards.view.management' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url WHERE url_path = '/dashboards/management');

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_module_url WHERE url_path = '/dashboards/management'; DELETE FROM clinlims.system_module WHERE name = 'dashboards.view.management';

changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: Grant the management dashboard to Global Administrator and every role holding qa.eqa.provider
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_module (id, has_select, has_add, has_update, has_delete, system_role_id, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_module_seq'), 'Y', 'N', 'N', 'N', r.id, m.id FROM clinlims.system_role r JOIN clinlims.system_module m ON m.name = 'dashboards.view.management' WHERE (r.name = 'Global Administrator' OR r.id IN (SELECT rm.system_role_id FROM clinlims.system_role_module rm JOIN clinlims.system_module p ON p.id = rm.system_module_id WHERE p.name = 'qa.eqa.provider')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module x WHERE x.system_role_id = r.id AND x.system_module_id = m.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_role_module WHERE system_module_id IN (SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_module WHERE name = 'dashboards.view.management');

changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: Add Management Overview as the first entry under Reports
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.menu (id, parent_id, presentation_order, element_id, action_url, display_key, tool_tip_key, new_window, is_active, hide_in_old_ui) SELECT nextval('clinlims.menu_seq'), p.id, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(c.presentation_order) FROM clinlims.menu c WHERE c.parent_id = p.id), 1) - 1, 'menu_reports_management_overview', '/dashboards/management', 'sideNav.title.managementOverview', 'sideNav.title.managementOverview', false, true, true FROM clinlims.menu p WHERE p.element_id = 'menu_reports' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_reports_management_overview');
